title: RODEL 2026-27
summary: The RODEL 26-27 was conducted on 9th September virtually at 9 pm.
description: The RODEL 26-27 was conducted on 9th September virtually at 9 pm. The debate topic was, "Third world Countries, with good growth should be given preferential treatment including concessions in RI dues". The debate was between Rotary club of Bombay Powai versus Rotary Club of Addiction Prevention and both the clubs did very well. From RCAP, Rtn Dr Nilam Gada, Rtn Dr Siddharth Udeshi and Rtn Hetal Sanghavi participated. Their defending points were to the point and sportive. After a good 8 min debate with intervals, our Club lost by 6 points. But the overall experience was fantastic.
